scope: Motion/H67 layer-island composition without a complex global scheduler or monolithic top-level RTL

composition_definition.unified_means: All selected islands obey one typed phase/epoch/tag and SRAM-bank ownership contract and are composed sequentially in the cycle simulator.
unified_does_not_mean: all islands active in the same cycle

mandatory_properties: one phase owner per shared SRAM port per cycle
stale epoch or generation responses cannot commit
a phase transition waits for accepted work and result drain
dynamic-BN FRONT must complete before coefficient commit and BACK replay
no local island may silently duplicate a shared macro or arithmetic pool

m167_does_not_replace: coefficient generator and reciprocal square root
resource_accounting_rules.m218_production_service_baseline: M219 is a K1 comparison island and is never summed into the proposed design.
resource_accounting_rules.m216_m218_relation: M216 is the proposed sparse descriptor frontend and M218 is the proposed finite-latency tagged slice service; both are counted once until a fused implementation proves resource removal.
resource_accounting_rules.rqtb_relation: RQTB owns attention-only structures; its local storage is not assumed to share ports or macros with FFN/patch islands without an explicit adapter.
resource_accounting_rules.patch_relation: Patch line buffers and PED shortcut state are absent today and must be counted if the M222 screen advances.
resource_accounting_rules.historical_modules: Characterization, superseded ablations, cropped baselines, and verification miters are not separate production blocks.

eligible_contribution_requires: DC timing and area for the critical module
a clear non-overlapping relationship to other contributions

next_gate: M222 frozen-H67 patch 3x3 plus PED K-bank/line-buffer/shared-commit same-resource cycle screen; fall back to an FC1 Acc19 K-bank screen if the patch point is below 1.5x.
